criteriaResults.reasoning: The skill prompt explicitly bans pure black, neon/outer glows, generic 3-column card layouts, and the Inter font under the 'AI TELLS (Forbidden Patterns)' section.

criteriaResults.description: Skill prompt requires all 7 interaction states (default, hover, active, focus, loading, empty, error)
criteriaResults.reasoning: The prompt explicitly requires full interaction cycles including loading, empty states, error states, tactile feedback (:active), focus indicators (:focus-visible), and hover states.

criteriaResults.description: Skill prompt specifies spring/ease curves, not linear. Avoids janky animations.
criteriaResults.reasoning: The prompt explicitly specifies using premium Spring Physics (stiffness: 100, damping: 20) and cubic-bezier curves, while explicitly banning linear easing.

criteriaResults.description: Skill prompt enforces clear typography hierarchy with specific font choices
criteriaResults.reasoning: The prompt enforces deterministic typography with specific classes for Display/Headlines and Body/Paragraphs, and mandates specific high-end fonts like Geist, Outfit, Cabinet Grotesk, or Satoshi.

criteriaResults.description: Skill prompt uses a deliberate color system, not arbitrary hex values
criteriaResults.reasoning: The prompt mandates a strict color calibration rule: max 1 accent color, saturation < 80%, absolute neutral bases (Zinc/Slate), and strict color consistency across the project.

criteriaResults.description: Skill prompt enforces consistent spacing scale (not random padding/margin values)
criteriaResults.reasoning: The prompt enforces mathematically perfect padding and margins, standardizes breakpoints, and mandates the use of Tailwind CSS which inherently enforces a consistent spacing scale.

criteriaResults.description: Skill prompt requires WCAG contrast ratios and focus-visible indicators
criteriaResults.reasoning: The prompt has a mandatory Accessibility section that explicitly requires WCAG 2.1 AA contrast ratios and clear focus-visible indicators for all interactive elements.
